categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in real estate development, focusing on residential and commercial buildings for sale and lease. Additional business includes urban planning parking lot investments, amusement parks, supermarkets, warehousing, land rezoning, industrial park development, building materials manufacturing and trading, interior decoration materials trading, advertising design, hospitality services, department store operations, property valuation, and real estate brokerage. The core market is domestic, with 100% of revenue from local sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Project Construction Management (PCM) to enhance design, construction quality, and project management efficiency. It emphasizes green building technologies, energy-saving designs, and sustainable materials to meet environmental standards and improve energy efficiency. Construction is outsourced to qualified contractors, while the company focuses on land development, market analysis, and project planning.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers and investors in Taiwan's metropolitan and redevelopment areas. The company targets self-use buyers and investors seeking residential and commercial properties in key urban locations such as Taichung, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and New Taipei City. Market demand is influenced by government policies, economic conditions, and demographic trends.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with projects located in major cities and redevelopment zones including Taichung City, Kaohsiung City, Taoyuan City, New Taipei City, Hsinchu City, and Miaoli County. The company focuses on urban and suburban areas with strong transportation infrastructure and industrial development potential.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, development planning, and project management. Construction is subcontracted to external contractors, while sales and marketing target end consumers. It coordinates upstream suppliers such as landowners and building material providers and downstream customers including homebuyers and tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding land reserves, enhancing brand value, and integrating sustainable green building practices. The company invests in BIM and PCM technologies to improve construction quality and efficiency. It emphasizes ESG principles, energy-saving designs, and customer service excellence. Future R&D focuses on smart living solutions, green materials, and adapting to market trends such as electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale and lease of residential and commercial real estate properties. The company also earns rental income from developed properties and management fees from joint development projects. Financing activities include convertible bonds and capital increases to support development projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other local real estate developers primarily within the same geographic regions and market segments. Competition is mainly project-based within specific districts rather than broad market share battles. The company differentiates through tailored product planning, green building certifications, and quality construction management to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported significant growth with 2024 revenue of approximately NT$5.33 billion, a 188% increase from the previous year, and net profit of NT$1.3 billion, up 438%. Total assets reached about NT$28.6 billion, with equity of NT$7.1 billion. The company has steadily increased capital through cash and convertible bond issuances and maintains a strong financial position with growing retained earnings and capital surplus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality construction, sustainable green building practices, and smart living features to provide superior residential and commercial properties. It integrates BIM and PCM for precise project management and quality assurance. The focus on ESG principles, energy efficiency, and customer-centric service aims to build a trusted brand and deliver long-term value to customers and shareholders.
